scope: Live private full-group publication visibility and scoped rollback after serialized negative receipt readback. Only current-operation unreferenced artifacts are eligible. Does not implement durable ownership recovery after abrupt process death or named-slot archive cleanup.

reproduction.failure: Actual Unix RPC stale Screen Finish left an extra image in legacy shared catalog; regression failed on image inventory, not merely a counter or staged-state assertion. Fixed regression additionally requires exact profile-group-changed CAS error and verifies image/font/video removal plus newer brightness52/shutdown flush.

contract.ownership: Callbacks after exclusive creation/publication of PNG, image name sidecar, font and indexed media register only that file with operation scope. No before/after directory difference. FileIdentity holds device/inode and a shared descriptor for the original inode, preventing inode reuse from masking replacement. Named upload metadata uses persist_noclobber; explicit rename retains revision-checked replacement.
contract.visibility: Scoped images/media hidden from list/list_named/with_catalog until successful/retained outcome; target preparation can resolve private keys. Underlying media quota still counts hidden files. Accepted commit, including known runtime Apply failure, retains and reveals assets. Normal codec/named-slot behavior is unchanged.
contract.rollback: Actor/preparation failure triggers another owner ReadGroupImport. Only proven absent receipt permits blocking scoped cleanup. Existing receipt or unavailable/unknown owner retains files; unavailable readback upgrades outcome to RecoveryRequired. Live/pending image/media pins, durable offline settings/profiles, external font reads, replaced/symlinked paths and renamed metadata retain files. Strict read/unknown schema or I/O error retains rather than inferring no references and appends cleanup error to original result.
contract.fonts: Ordinary load observes a font for session retention. Candidate loads only its own publication keys through explicit exemption; own failed preparation does not count as external adoption. Foreign/existing fonts keep ordinary behavior.
contract.lifetime: Known rollback/retention and original ownership-descriptor closure awaited in blocking workers before terminal Finish/admission release. Visibility markers released for retained or errored records too. Panic/unknown Drop fallback retains files; no blind undo after commit.
contract.limits: Ownership records and descriptors bounded by archive entries plus image sidecars; ordinary OS file-descriptor/resource limits apply. This is transient same-store-instance ownership, not a cross-process durable ledger.

regressions.coverage: Actual private Unix RPC/DeviceManager/MockBackend: image+font+unused gallery video, source upload/Inspect, independent upload during operation, newer LCD brightness52 then exact stale CAS rejection. Original user image/font/video and independent upload intact; candidate files absent, no receipt, legacy collection None; current LCD52 and final shutdown flush52.

Two actual scoped codec publications plus independent upload; image/media catalogs exclude both pending scopes. Rollback A removes only its image/name/font/video; B and ordinary upload survive. Retain B reveals usable assets.
Independent image and media leases and ordinary font load preserve adopted files through failed-scope rollback.
Offline device theme and explicit collections preserve all saved dependencies. Explicit uncertain-outcome retention reveals rather than deletes a separate scope.
Real filesystem failure at font publication after PNG/name succeed removes own published prefix, leaves foreign blocking file untouched.
Replace pending font path while original descriptor held; rename pending image metadata through normal revision CAS. Both adopted/replaced files retained.
Create foreign sidecar between PNG creation and name publication using actual synchronous creation callback. No-overwrite fails import; rollback leaves foreign bytes intact.

checks.hardware: NOT RUN; user deferred, no physical device accessed

remaining: Durable publication ownership/reconciliation after process death; transient pending state is lost on restart and cannot authorize directory-diff deletion
Extended fsync/FD exhaustion/panic/shutdown and unknown-receipt/lifecycle workload qualification
Scoped cleanup for named-slot archive publication, which still uses original codec path
Explicit full-group reapply IPC/CLI and GUI import/export; remaining basic parity roadmap
Real hardware acceptance deferred; additional LCD effects/Style Express last
